body: I updated IDL in the commit https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/2787/commits/4bf4a2c803aded02af037db741d71ee8768004f7
Beside the bunch of nits overall looks good to me. I believe at the end you need @domenic's approval as he is the expert for this spec and he has also requested some changes.

Starting to look quite good, thanks for working on this and for your patience with us! Mostly editorial things. The one possibly non-editorial thing is @NavidZ's comment starting with "I suggest not having this condition". I haven't looked at the CSSOM spec enough to know what the right thing to do is in that regard.
I'm happy with the IDL, but the prose needs more work to actually do what it's intended to do, I believe.
